trello.summary: A board with its lists, cards, labels, checklists and comments.
trello.step2: Choose Menu, then Print, export and share, then Export as JSON.
trello.step3: Save the file and upload it here. Archived cards are left out.
trello.carries: Lists become statuses. Cards, descriptions, due dates, labels, members, checklists and comments carry over.

jira.summary: Issues with their type, status, assignee, sprint, story points and parent.
jira.step1: In Jira, open Filters and search for the issues you want (or open a project backlog).
jira.step2: Choose Export, then Export Excel CSV (all fields).
jira.step3: Upload the downloaded file here. Up to 2,000 issues fit in one import, so split bigger projects.
jira.carries: Epics, sub-tasks, sprints, labels, priority, story points, due dates and comments carry over.

csv.label: CSV file
csv.summary: Any spreadsheet saved as CSV, one task per row.
csv.step1: Download the template and fill in one row per task, or use your own file with a title column.
csv.step2: Save it as CSV (comma or semicolon separated, UTF-8).
csv.step3: Upload it here. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD.
csv.carries: Columns are found by name: title, description, status, priority, type, labels, assignee_email, due_date, start_date, story_points, parent_id and id.
